capabilities: Write screenplays in Fountain syntax in .fountain files or Markdown notes with screenplay frontmatter
Export screenplays to clean .fountain, Final Draft .fdx, and paginated PDF files
Manage multi-file screenplay projects with ordered parts and a scene workspace
Create character dossiers and run continuity checks for aliases, duplicates, and broken links
Insert characters, parentheticals, and transitions via autocomplete, commands, and a palette
disambiguation: Not a general drafting or prose-writing assistant; it is a Fountain-syntax tool for screenplays specifically.
extras: Local-only with no telemetry or network use; CJK PDF export requires a separately installed offline Noto font pack per device; README notes the manifest has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted screenplay-aware assistance while keeping documents portable, human-readable, and usable without the plugin installed.
problem: Obsidian has no screenplay-aware editing, element parsing, or screenplay-standard PDF and Final Draft export for writers working in plain text.

relations.evidence: non-destructive Final Draft .fdx export for the six core screenplay element types

summary: Screenplay-writing plugin that adds Fountain-syntax screenplay mode to notes, with scene workspace, character dossiers, and PDF/FDX export.
